Preserve federation and sharing policy, including archive moves and zero archive timestamps. Add handler-level work-count and viewer-isolation regression coverage (74 test lines), plus a 60k-row synthetic update-stream benchmark. Production code shrinks by three lines. * test(perf): measure cold session-list thread CPU * perf(gateway): skip hashing before session partitions exist * test(gateway): pin archived-only profile reference resolution * test(gateway): align retained checks with archive partitions
